remarks: This sophisticatedly remodeled antique is bright, spacious with an easy traditional layout and attention to detail. The first floor features an open kitchen/LR layout with two fireplaces, and large eating area w/walk in pantry. Off there you'll find a large formal dining room with a wall of French doors. Office with built-ins, Family room, laundry room, and mud room round out the main level (FR & LR can be swapped on preference). Upstairs is where you'll find five generously sized bedrooms and three full baths. The primary features an impressive walk-in closet with island and custom shelving, and a large bathroom with separate tub and shower, and two separate vanities. One of the bedrooms currently used as an office has a built-in desk and a Murphy bed for easy conversion to a guest room. Another room across the hall shares a large bath with a double vanity. Down the hall are two more bedrooms one of which has an elegantly renovated en-suite bath. The house has great closet space and 2 pull-down attics for additional storage. Extra-large windows and French doors throughout make for a bright and sunny home. The outdoor space is an oasis with a patio and sitting wall offering room for dining, and a fireplace area for lounging. Lots of professionally landscaped lawn to play on. Mostly newer mechanicals, oil tank, and sewer on the street. Nothing to do but move in and enjoy the private yet convenient location.
